headline: Desired capacity cannot be lower than minimum size — the ASG will ignore this change and continue running 3 instances

findings.evidence_ref: desired_capacity set to 1 in compute.tf diff, but min_size remains 3 in the same resource
findings.explanation: AWS autoscaling groups maintain at least min_size instances regardless of desired_capacity. This change will have no effect; the fleet will continue running 3 instances overnight, and the cost savings will not materialize. To scale down, min_size must also be reduced to 1.
